title: BitMart documents its Earn fixed-savings product
description: BitMart published an introduction to its Earn hub and fixed Savings products, including fixed terms and stated APYs for supported assets.
notes: This is the earliest reviewed product-specific date, not necessarily the first launch date of every BitMart Earn product.

title: BitMart announces an orderly platform wind-down
description: BitMart announced that it would wind down trading-platform operations and discontinue Earn, Staking, Lending, Launchpad, and other products in phases under product-specific arrangements.
notes: The notice is a schedule and process announcement. It does not establish completion of product redemption, trading cessation, or platform termination as of 5 August 2026.

title: BitMart begins restricting registrations, deposits, and new activity
description: BitMart began gradually stopping new registrations, cryptocurrency and fiat deposits, new spot orders, new futures positions, and automated trading services as part of the wind-down.
notes: The measures began at 01:30 UTC and were described as gradual. Withdrawal services remained available subject to compliance and security review.

title: BitMart schedules cessation of trading services
description: BitMart scheduled all spot, futures, and other trading services to end at 01:00 UTC on 26 August 2026, with remaining positions subject to applicable settlement rules.
notes: This is a future scheduled event as of the 5 August 2026 review date. It must be reverified after the deadline before being converted to a completed operations-ended event.

title: BitMart schedules formal platform termination
description: BitMart planned to cease trading-platform operations at 15:59 UTC on 31 January 2027 while retaining limited post-termination account and withdrawal access for a specified period.
notes: This is a future scheduled event as of the 5 August 2026 review date and is not evidence that operations have already ended.

title: Kriptomat temporarily pauses KriptoEarn
description: Kriptomat paused new KriptoEarn deposits because market vulnerabilities could affect external partners and said existing principal and rewards through 10 November would be transferred to customers' regular Kriptomat wallets.
notes: Kriptomat stated that it had no liquidity issue. Later product pages indicate KriptoEarn became available again, but the exact restart date was not established.

title: Kriptomat announces a MiCA-related orderly wind-down
description: Kriptomat announced that it would stop offering crypto services by 30 June 2026 after withdrawing its MiCA authorisation application, while stating that it remained solvent and customer assets were available for withdrawal.
notes: The announcement described a regulatory and business wind-down rather than insolvency, fraud, misconduct, or an enforcement shutdown.

title: KriptoEarn positions and regulated Kriptomat services end
description: Kriptomat's wind-down hub marked termination of KriptoEarn positions and the 30 June cessation of regulated services as completed, with assets moved to main wallets and residual balances transferred to read-only and manual-processing procedures.
notes: Internal-wallet return and service termination do not prove that every customer completed an external withdrawal, Kraken transfer, manual claim, or account closure.
